nodes.label: Scene Render Loop

nodes.label: Texture State Management

nodes.label: glTF Accessor/BufferView/Buffer Hierarchy

nodes.label: glTF Primitive as Draw Call

nodes.label: Pimpl/Inner Class Loader Pattern

nodes.label: Framebuffer RAII Design
nodes.summary: RAII Framebuffer class with constructor/destructor managing FBO lifetime, moveable but non-copyable.

nodes.label: Render-to-Texture Workflow
nodes.summary: Create FBO â†’ create texture â†’ attach â†’ bind â†’ render â†’ unbind â†’ use texture in ImGui or shaders.

nodes.label: Framebuffer Attachments
nodes.summary: Color (GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0+slot) and depth (GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT) texture attachments via glFramebufferTexture2D.

nodes.label: Framebuffer Completeness Validation
nodes.summary: IsComplete() calls glCheckFramebufferStatus; must be checked after attaching all textures.

nodes.label: Empty Texture for FBO
nodes.summary: Texture constructor with nullptr data allocates GPU memory without uploading pixels, for FBO attachment.

nodes.label: Viewport Management
nodes.summary: Bind() automatically sets viewport to FBO dimensions; Renderer::SetViewport wraps glViewport for DLL safety.

nodes.label: Texture Lifetime Management
nodes.summary: Framebuffer stores shared_ptr<Texture> for color and depth attachments to prevent dangling FBO references.

nodes.label: Texture Filtering Modes
nodes.summary: GL_NEAREST (pixelated), GL_LINEAR (smooth), GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR (trilinear, best for 3D).

nodes.label: Texture Wrap Modes
nodes.summary: GL_REPEAT, GL_MIRRORED_REPEAT, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE, GL_CLAMP_TO_BORDER and their appropriate use cases.

nodes.label: Texture Border Color
nodes.summary: SetBorderColor with white (1,1,1,1) for shadow maps so out-of-bounds areas are treated as not-in-shadow.

nodes.label: SetFilter Method
nodes.summary: Texture::SetFilter binds texture, sets GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER and GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, then unbinds.

nodes.label: SetWrap Method
nodes.summary: Texture::SetWrap sets GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S and GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T; S=horizontal, T=vertical.

nodes.label: Shadow Map Texture Configuration
nodes.summary: Shadow maps need GL_LINEAR filter, GL_CLAMP_TO_BORDER wrap, and white border to avoid edge artifacts.

nodes.label: Practical Texture Configurations
nodes.summary: Usage patterns: shadow map config, render target clamp-to-edge, tiled floor repeat+trilinear.

nodes.label: Shadow Mapping Overview
nodes.summary: Two-pass technique: depth pass from light's POV to shadow map, then shading pass comparing fragment depth.

nodes.label: Two-Pass Rendering
nodes.summary: Pass 1 binds shadow FBO and shadow depth shader; Pass 2 binds screen FBO and lit shader with shadow map.

nodes.label: Light-Space Matrix
nodes.summary: lightProjection * lightView transforms world positions to light's NDC; orthographic for directional lights.

nodes.label: Orthographic Light Projection
nodes.summary: glm::ortho used for directional lights (parallel rays); orthoSize controls shadow coverage area.

nodes.label: Shadow Depth Shader
nodes.summary: Minimal vertex shader transforming to light clip space; empty fragment shader (depth written automatically).

nodes.label: Polygon Offset for Acne
nodes.summary: glPolygonOffset(factor, units) shifts depth during rasterization to prevent self-shadowing artifacts.

nodes.label: Depth Comparison in Shader
nodes.summary: Fragment transforms to light space, samples shadow map, compares currentDepth-bias > closestDepth.

nodes.label: Cubemap Texture Type
nodes.summary: GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP: 6 square 2D faces arranged as a cube, sampled with 3D direction vectors instead of UV coordinates.

nodes.label: HDR Texture Loading
nodes.summary: Loading .hdr equirectangular images via stbi_loadf() into GL_RGB16F floating-point textures to preserve HDR range beyond [0,1].

nodes.label: Equirectangular-to-Cubemap Conversion
nodes.summary: One-time GPU conversion: render 6 faces using a shader that maps 3D direction vectors to equirectangular UV via atan/asin spherical coordinates.

nodes.label: Cubemap Wrap Modes (S/T/R)
nodes.summary: Cubemaps require GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE for all three wrap axes (S, T, and R) to avoid seams at face boundaries.

nodes.label: Empty Cubemap Constructor
nodes.summary: Texture(int resolution, bool isHDR) constructor creates an empty 6-face cubemap target for FBO-based rendering.

nodes.label: Framebuffer-Based Cubemap Baking
nodes.summary: CubemapUtils::EquirectangularToCubemap renders the equirect map to each of 6 cubemap faces using a Framebuffer, performed once at load time.

nodes.label: CubemapUtils Class
nodes.summary: Static utility class providing EquirectangularToCubemap() and future IBL baking methods (irradiance map, prefiltered map, BRDF LUT).

nodes.label: IBL Foundation
nodes.summary: HDR cubemaps will be reused in Chapter 38 for image-based lighting: irradiance maps for diffuse and prefiltered maps for specular.

nodes.label: Skybox Rendering Technique
nodes.summary: Rendering an environment cube that surrounds the camera at all times using cubemap textures and specialized shader techniques.

nodes.label: GL_LEQUAL Depth Function for Skybox
nodes.summary: glDepthFunc(GL_LEQUAL) allows fragments at exactly depth=1.0 to pass the depth test so the far-plane skybox is visible.

nodes.label: Disable Depth Mask for Skybox
nodes.summary: glDepthMask(GL_FALSE) disables depth writing during skybox rendering so the skybox does not occlude scene geometry.

nodes.label: Skybox Class Design
nodes.summary: Reusable Skybox class encapsulating cubemap texture, VAO/VBO for a unit cube, skybox shader, and Render(camera) method.

nodes.label: Skybox Cube Mesh Setup
nodes.summary: SetupMesh() builds a 36-vertex unit cube (positions only) in a VAO/VBO for skybox rendering â€” no normals or UVs needed.

nodes.label: Environment Reflections Preview
nodes.summary: The skybox cubemap will be reused in Chapter 37 for environment reflections on metallic surfaces via the reflect() vector.

nodes.label: samplerCube GLSL Uniform
nodes.summary: The skybox fragment shader uses 'uniform samplerCube u_Skybox' and samples with the 3D direction vector passed from the vertex shader.

nodes.label: Depth Test Functions
nodes.summary: GL_LESS (default), GL_LEQUAL (skyboxes), GL_GREATER (reverse-Z), GL_ALWAYS, etc. configure which fragments pass the Z-buffer test.

nodes.label: Depth Mask Control
nodes.summary: SetDepthMask(bool) enables/disables depth writes independently of depth testing â€” critical for transparent objects and skyboxes.

nodes.label: Stencil Buffer
nodes.summary: 8-bit per-pixel integer mask alongside depth/color buffers, configured via glStencilFunc/glStencilOp/glStencilMask for programmable masking.

nodes.label: Two-Pass Stencil Outline Algorithm
nodes.summary: Pass 1: render object with GL_REPLACE writing stencil=1. Pass 2: render scaled-up object with GL_NOTEQUAL to draw outline only outside silhouette.

nodes.label: Face Culling
nodes.summary: Skipping back-facing triangles (CCW winding = front face) via glEnable(GL_CULL_FACE); saves ~50% rasterization on closed meshes.

nodes.label: Combined Depth-Stencil FBO Attachment
nodes.summary: GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8 format packs 24-bit depth and 8-bit stencil into one texture, attached via GL_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT.

nodes.label: Renderer DLL State Wrapping
nodes.summary: All OpenGL state calls (glDepthFunc, glStencilOp, etc.) are wrapped as Renderer methods to maintain DLL boundary safety without GLAD symbol leakage.

nodes.label: StencilFunc / StencilOp / StencilMask Trio
nodes.summary: Three OpenGL calls that control stencil test condition, buffer write operations (KEEP/REPLACE/INCR), and which stencil bits are writable.

nodes.label: Blending Equation
nodes.summary: Result = SourceColor * SrcFactor + DestColor * DstFactor; default equation GL_FUNC_ADD combines incoming fragment with existing framebuffer color.

nodes.label: Standard Alpha Blending
nodes.summary: GL_SRC_ALPHA / GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA produces classic transparency: result = frag.rgb * frag.a + bg.rgb * (1 - frag.a).

nodes.label: Two-Pass Opaque/Transparent Rendering
nodes.summary: Pass 1: render all opaque objects (Color.a == 1.0) with normal depth test+write. Pass 2: sort transparent objects back-to-front, render with blending ON + depth write OFF.

nodes.label: Depth Mask Off During Transparent Pass
nodes.summary: SetDepthMask(false) during the transparent pass keeps depth testing active (transparent occluded by opaque) but prevents transparent objects from occluding each other.

nodes.label: Alpha via u_ObjectColor.w
nodes.summary: No dedicated u_Alpha uniform needed â€” defaultlit.shader already outputs FragColor.a = texColor.a * u_ObjectColor.a, so obj.Color.a drives transparency automatically.

nodes.label: Tangent Space (TBN)
nodes.summary: Local coordinate system at each surface point: T (along U), B (along V), N (surface normal). Forms orthonormal basis for transforming normal map vectors.

nodes.label: TBN Matrix Construction
nodes.summary: mat3(T, B, N) in vertex shader transforms tangent-space normal to world space; built by transforming all three basis vectors through the normal matrix.

nodes.label: ComputeTangents Algorithm
nodes.summary: Per-triangle edge/deltaUV method: solves 2x2 UV linear system for T and B, accumulates per-vertex, then Gram-Schmidt orthogonalizes against the surface normal.

nodes.label: Gram-Schmidt Orthogonalization
nodes.summary: T' = normalize(T - N * dot(N,T)) removes T's component along N; bitangent recomputed as cross(N, T') to guarantee an orthogonal TBN frame.

nodes.label: Vertex Stride Extension to 19 Floats
nodes.summary: Adding Tangent (vec3) and Bitangent (vec3) to Vertex struct increases stride from 13 to 19 floats (76 bytes); all factory methods and the glTF loader must produce valid tangent data.

nodes.label: glTF TANGENT Attribute Loading
nodes.summary: glTF stores TANGENT as vec4 (xyz=direction, w=handedness sign). Bitangent = cross(N, T) * w. Falls back to edge/deltaUV computation if TANGENT is absent.

nodes.label: Normal Map Fragment Shader
nodes.summary: u_NormalTexture and u_UseNormalMap uniforms in defaultlit.shader; when enabled, samples the map, remaps to [-1,1], and transforms via interpolated v_TBN for per-pixel lighting.

nodes.label: GPU Instancing
nodes.summary: Core technique: one draw call renders N identical meshes by storing per-instance transforms in a VBO and using glDrawElementsInstanced.

nodes.label: glDrawElementsInstanced
nodes.summary: OpenGL call that draws N instances of a mesh in a single submission; vertex shader receives gl_InstanceID per invocation.

nodes.label: glVertexAttribDivisor
nodes.summary: Sets per-instance attribute advancement rate; divisor=1 means each instance reads the next row from the instance VBO.

nodes.label: mat4 Split Across 4 Attribute Locations
nodes.summary: A mat4 (64 bytes) is passed as 4 consecutive vec4 attributes (locations 6-9) because a single attribute slot holds at most 4 floats.

nodes.label: Instanced Shader
nodes.summary: instanced.shader reads per-vertex data at locations 0-5 and per-instance model matrix columns at locations 6-9; applies Blinn-Phong lighting.

nodes.label: 10x10 Grid Instancing Demo
nodes.summary: SetupInstancingDemo creates 100 cube transforms, uploads them to a VBO, links via LinkInstanceBuffer, and renders the grid in one DrawInstanced call.

nodes.label: Cook-Torrance BRDF
nodes.summary: Industry-standard specular model: f_spec = (D*F*G)/(4*NdotV*NdotL), combining NDF, Fresnel, and Geometry terms.

nodes.label: GGX Normal Distribution Function
nodes.summary: Trowbridge-Reitz GGX NDF: D = alpha^2 / (pi * ((NdotH)^2*(alpha^2-1)+1)^2) where alpha = roughness^2; controls specular lobe shape.

nodes.label: Fresnel-Schlick Approximation
nodes.summary: F = F0 + (1-F0)*(1 - HdotV)^5; models grazing-angle increase in reflectivity. F0 = 0.04 for dielectrics, albedo for metals.

nodes.label: Metallic-Roughness Material Workflow
nodes.summary: Albedo, Metallic [0,1], Roughness [0,1], AO as the four artist-facing PBR parameters used by glTF, UE4, Unity.

nodes.label: PBR Shader (defaultlit.shader) Upgrade
nodes.summary: Replaces Blinn-Phong in defaultlit.shader with full Cook-Torrance BRDF; adds u_Metallic, u_AO, u_NormalMatrix, albedo texture, multi-light loop.

nodes.label: F0 Metallic Workflow
nodes.summary: F0 = mix(vec3(0.04), albedo, metallic); dielectrics get gray F0=0.04, metals use albedo as F0 producing tinted reflections.

nodes.label: Multi-Light Accumulation Loop
nodes.summary: Fragment shader loops over up to 4 point lights plus an optional directional light, accumulating Cook-Torrance contribution per light.

nodes.label: PBRMaterial Class Integration
nodes.summary: PBRMaterial holds albedo, metallic, roughness, AO, and texture references; UploadParameters sends all uniforms to the PBR shader.

nodes.label: Energy Conservation Implementation
nodes.summary: kS=F, kD=(1-F)*(1-metallic) enforces that diffuse + specular <= 1; metals zero out diffuse, all energy goes to specular.

nodes.label: Image-Based Lighting (IBL) Overview
nodes.summary: Replaces flat ambient with environment-derived diffuse irradiance and specular pre-filtered reflections; uses split-sum approximation (Karis 2013).

nodes.label: Irradiance Map (Diffuse IBL)
nodes.summary: 32x32 cubemap storing hemisphere-convolved environment lighting per normal direction; low-frequency signal, sufficient at small resolution.

nodes.label: Pre-filtered Environment Map (Specular IBL)
nodes.summary: 512x512 cubemap with 5 mip levels storing roughness-blurred environment; mip 0=mirror, mip 4=fully rough; sampled via textureLod.

nodes.label: BRDF Integration LUT
nodes.summary: 512x512 RG16F texture storing Fresnel scale/bias indexed by (NdotV, roughness); environment-independent, generated once at startup.

nodes.label: IBL Ambient Term in PBR Shader
nodes.summary: ambient = (kD*irradiance*albedo + prefilteredColor*(F0*envBRDF.x+envBRDF.y))*AO*IBLIntensity; FresnelSchlickRoughness used for IBL Fresnel.

nodes.label: Lower Hemisphere Fallback Color
nodes.summary: SetLowerHemisphereColor provides a ground-plane tint for environments that don't capture below the horizon, avoiding black undersides.

nodes.label: IBL Generation Startup Cost
nodes.summary: Irradiance ~500ms, prefilter ~2-3s, BRDF LUT ~200ms; total 3-4s one-time cost; runtime cost is only 3 texture lookups (~0.1ms/frame).

nodes.label: HDR Framebuffer (RGB16F)
nodes.summary: GL_RGB16F floating-point color attachment stores unbounded HDR values [0,inf); SceneRenderer::CreateHDRFramebuffer sets this up.

nodes.label: Two-Pass HDR Rendering
nodes.summary: Pass 1: PBR scene to HDR framebuffer; Pass 2: tone mapping shader reads HDR texture and writes to screen via fullscreen quad.

nodes.label: Tone Mapping Operators
nodes.summary: Five operators: Reinhard, Reinhard Extended, Exposure-based, ACES Filmic (Stephen Hill), Uncharted 2 (Hable); ACES recommended for production.

nodes.label: Exposure Control and Auto-Adaptation
nodes.summary: Manual exposure (f-stop simulation) and automatic eye-adaptation via mipmap average luminance with temporal smoothing.

nodes.label: FullscreenQuad for Post-Processing
nodes.summary: FullscreenQuad class renders an NDC quad (-1,-1) to (1,1); used in the tone mapping pass to process the HDR framebuffer texture.

nodes.label: Post-Process Pipeline
nodes.summary: PostProcessPipeline::Process() orchestrates the tone mapping pass; owns the tone mapping shader and reads from the HDR framebuffer.

nodes.label: Bloom Post-Processing Effect
nodes.description: Physically-based bloom simulating lens scatter around bright HDR regions using bright-pass filtering and Gaussian blur.

nodes.label: Separable Gaussian Blur (Two-Pass)
nodes.description: Decomposes 2D Gaussian blur into horizontal and vertical 1D passes, reducing texture fetches from N^2 to 2N.

nodes.label: Ping-Pong Framebuffer Pattern
nodes.description: Alternating between two framebuffers (BlurFB1/BlurFB2) to avoid read/write conflicts during iterative blur passes.

nodes.label: Bloom Class (Encapsulated Pipeline)
nodes.description: Reusable post-processing component owning extraction/blur framebuffers and shaders, exposing a single Process() method.

nodes.label: Fullscreen Quad for Post-Processing
nodes.description: FullscreenQuad renders a screen-aligned triangle/quad to apply image-space effects such as bloom extraction and blur.

nodes.label: HDR Framebuffer Integration for Bloom
nodes.description: Bloom operates on an RGB16F HDR framebuffer, using downsampled bloom buffers at half resolution to reduce cost.

nodes.label: Post-Processing Pipeline Architecture
nodes.description: Ordered pipeline: Scene â†’ HDR â†’ Bloom Extract â†’ Blur â†’ Composite â†’ Tone Map â†’ Gamma â†’ Screen.

nodes.label: Color Grading
nodes.description: Post-production process of altering image colors to establish mood and visual identity, operating in LDR space after tone mapping.

nodes.label: 3D Look-Up Table (LUT)
nodes.description: Pre-baked color transformation stored as a 3D texture (typically 16x16x16) mapping input RGB to output RGB via sampler3D.

nodes.label: Neutral (Identity) LUT Generation
nodes.description: Identity LUT where each voxel (r,g,b) stores the normalized RGB value, producing no color transformation when sampled.

nodes.label: Texture3D RAII Class
nodes.description: RAII wrapper for OpenGL GL_TEXTURE_3D objects ensuring automatic glDeleteTextures on destruction via unique_ptr.

nodes.label: Color Grading in LDR Space
nodes.description: Color grading applied after tone mapping in [0,1] LDR space, in contrast to bloom which operates in HDR space.

nodes.label: Complete Post-Processing Pipeline
nodes.description: Scene â†’ HDR â†’ Bloom â†’ Tone Map â†’ Color Grade â†’ Gamma â†’ Screen; each stage is independent and toggle-able.

nodes.label: RenderMaterial Base Class
nodes.description: Abstract base encapsulating a Shader reference, type-safe parameter map (std::variant), and texture slots with a single Bind() call.

nodes.label: PBRMaterial Class
nodes.description: Concrete RenderMaterial subclass pre-configured for metallic-roughness PBR workflow with albedo, IBL, and shadow map bindings.

nodes.label: UnlitMaterial Class
nodes.description: Simple material for UI, debug, and skybox rendering with color/texture and MVP matrix, no lighting calculations.

nodes.label: MaterialFactory
nodes.description: Factory providing static methods to create pre-configured PBR and Unlit materials plus named presets (Gold, Chrome, Plastic).

nodes.label: Single Bind() Call Pattern
nodes.description: material->Bind() triggers shader bind, BindTextures(), and UploadParameters() in one call, eliminating scattered uniform code.

nodes.label: Separation: Material vs Renderer Responsibilities
nodes.description: Materials own surface properties (albedo, metallic, IBL textures); renderers set transforms and lighting directly on shader.

nodes.label: UploadParameters via std::visit
nodes.description: std::visit over MaterialParameterValue variant dispatches to the correct shader uniform setter (SetFloat, SetVec3, SetMatrix4fv, etc.).

nodes.label: SceneRenderer Orchestrator
nodes.description: Central class composing shadow pass, polymorphic render path, skybox, stencil outlines, and post-processing into one Render() call.

nodes.label: Strategy Pattern for Render Paths
nodes.description: RenderPath abstract base allows runtime swapping of Forward, Forward+, and Deferred strategies via SetRenderPath().

nodes.label: ForwardRenderPath
nodes.description: Concrete forward rendering path extracted from SandboxApp: opaque/transparent separation, back-to-front sort, instanced draw.

nodes.label: RenderPassData Struct
nodes.description: Data contract struct passed from SceneRenderer to active RenderPath containing scene, camera, lights, shadow, and IBL data.

nodes.label: PostProcessPipeline Class
nodes.description: Extracted post-processing compositor owning Bloom, tone mapping shader, and Texture3D LUT; exposes Process() and OnResize().

nodes.label: HDR Framebuffer Creation in SceneRenderer
nodes.description: SceneRenderer::CreateHDRFramebuffer() provisions the shared RGB16F color texture and depth texture used by all render paths.

nodes.label: Monolith Refactoring (SandboxApp 1660â†’970 lines)
nodes.description: Extracting shadow, forward render, post-processing, and outline passes from SandboxApp::OnRender() into composable classes.
